title: mv -J record
description: One action of `mv -J`, written as it completes, where `mv -v` would print a line. Error records are in the same stream. One record per line (NDJSON); version 1 of the Dogfish record format (doc/ndjson.md). Fields may be added in later releases.

source.description: What the action read from or acted on, as named on the command line or below it.

source_bytes.description: The bytes of `source`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`source` then holds the lossy form).

dest.description: What the action created or replaced.

dest_bytes.description: The bytes of `dest`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`dest` then holds the lossy form).

type.description: The file type of what was moved.

backup.description: The --backup name the destination's earlier file was renamed to.

backup_bytes.description: The bytes of `backup`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`backup` then holds the lossy form).

undo_id.description: The `dogfish undo` id of the journal entry this action belongs to (`dogfish undo ID` reverses the whole operand).

action.description: A file copied (`mv -v` shows `SOURCE -> DEST`); a directory's record comes when it is created, before its contents.

source.description: What the action read from or acted on, as named on the command line or below it.

source_bytes.description: The bytes of `source`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`source` then holds the lossy form).

dest.description: What the action created or replaced.

dest_bytes.description: The bytes of `dest`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`dest` then holds the lossy form).

bytes.description: Bytes of data copied (regular files only).

backup.description: The --backup name the destination's earlier file was renamed to.

backup_bytes.description: The bytes of `backup`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`backup` then holds the lossy form).

undo_id.description: The `dogfish undo` id of the journal entry this action belongs to (`dogfish undo ID` reverses the whole operand).

anyOf.description: Across file systems: a file copied before its source is removed.

action.description: Across file systems: a directory created for the copy.

path.description: The file acted on, as named on the command line or below it.

path_bytes.description: The bytes of `path`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`path` then holds the lossy form).

undo_id.description: The `dogfish undo` id of the journal entry this action belongs to (`dogfish undo ID` reverses the whole operand).

action.description: Across file systems: a source file removed after the copy, or a destination removed to make way.

path.description: The file acted on, as named on the command line or below it.

path_bytes.description: The bytes of `path`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`path` then holds the lossy form).

undo_id.description: The `dogfish undo` id of the journal entry this action belongs to (`dogfish undo ID` reverses the whole operand).

action.description: Across file systems: a source directory removed after the copy.

path.description: The file acted on, as named on the command line or below it.

path_bytes.description: The bytes of `path`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`path` then holds the lossy form).

undo_id.description: The `dogfish undo` id of the journal entry this action belongs to (`dogfish undo ID` reverses the whole operand).

action.description: The destination's earlier file renamed to its --backup name, just before the action that replaced it (the next record).

source_bytes.description: The bytes of `source`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`source` then holds the lossy form).

dest_bytes.description: The bytes of `dest`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`dest` then holds the lossy form).

action.description: A backup renamed back, after the action that was to replace its file failed (`-v`: `(unbackup)`).

source_bytes.description: The bytes of `source`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`source` then holds the lossy form).

dest_bytes.description: The bytes of `dest`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`dest` then holds the lossy form).

error.description: An error record: the structured twin of a diagnostic the tool also printed on standard error, in order with the other records.
The diagnostic as printed on standard error, without the `tool: ` prefix.

path.description: The file the diagnostic names first, as given.

path_bytes.description: The bytes of `path`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`path` then holds the lossy form).

errno.description: The system error number, when the diagnostic ends with its message (2 for `No such file or directory`).
